initiatives.name: The Injustice Project / Injustice Archive
initiatives.description: A future testimony initiative with protected intake, review, and individual publication decisions.
initiatives.overview: People whose rights may have been violated, witnesses, family members, and others seeking to document harmful conduct should be able to understand choices before disclosing information.

initiatives.name: The Public Record
initiatives.description: A planned civic program for public-record requests and the responsible publication of official responses.
initiatives.overview: People will be able to learn about records requests, inspect request status, and examine official responses when the separate participation service is verified.

initiatives.name: Liberty Nodes
initiatives.description: A planned distributed archive for approved public materials and independent integrity checks.
initiatives.overview: Technically experienced volunteers may eventually help preserve and verify materials explicitly approved for public publication. This will not contain restricted private testimony.

initiatives.name: Justice Teams
initiatives.description: A proposed way to connect people seeking assistance with voluntary skills and support.
initiatives.overview: The dedicated service will require identity, eligibility, case-routing and consent controls before any matching or private communication.

initiatives.name: Witness Corps
initiatives.description: A planned responsible-observation and incident-documentation initiative.
initiatives.overview: Volunteer observers may eventually receive training materials and submit incident records through protected workflows, with publication separate from intake.

initiatives.name: One Question
initiatives.description: A planned public accountability and response-tracking initiative.
initiatives.overview: Participants will be able to examine documented questions posed to officials and distinguish answers from questions that remain unanswered.

initiatives.name: Justice Works
initiatives.description: A future platform for voluntary artistic and educational collaborations.
initiatives.overview: Creative contributors may work with public accounts only through appropriate permissions, attribution and responsible contextualization.

initiatives.name: Public Witness
initiatives.description: A planned hub for peaceful public participation and civic observation.
initiatives.overview: Events and educational materials may become available after organizers verify their accuracy, accessibility and any applicable requirements.

initiatives.name: Human Firewall / Consent Strike
initiatives.description: A future educational and voluntary-commitment initiative about data sharing.
initiatives.overview: The project will explain lawful privacy and consent choices without presuming participation, tracking nonparticipants or pressuring anyone.

initiatives.name: Surveillance-Enabler Boycott
initiatives.description: A proposed research and voluntary consumer-information program.
initiatives.overview: Publicly documented source material and clear distinctions between verified facts and commentary must precede company-specific pages.
